title: Updated: I’m Not Angry, I’m Disappointed: October 2020 Box
text:
2/11/21 I just wanted to do a quick update. They finally did manage to get the balance of the box sorted. They have been steadily getting the value up to $100 in the box. Also they have been sending at least one full size cosmetic with each box which is awesome.

I still ended up going ahead and temporarily canceling my subscription because my cupboards runnerh over with beauty products. So I would say give it a go try a month it’s easy to cancel.
———————————————————————
So I’ve been subscribing to this box for almost two years off and on, and I’ve enjoyed it. There have been amazing boxes that have introduced me to excellent products. And there have been mediocre months where I was just not impressed. Never in the time I’ve subscribed to this box have I felt ripped off. I have looked up retail values ensuring I was still getting a good deal and making sure I was getting a full-sized item. Never before have I felt that I needed to look up the prices to make sure I wasn’t getting ripped off. For the first time, I feel ripped off.

The nail polish (a $16 value) is nice, and the eye serum (which looks like a sample size but is a full-size item that retails at $60) makes the value. But I open a larger box that costs more and expect to see ”three full-size products,” and instead, I find a grab bag from a trip to the mall. I open a box, and it's half full, no packing material, and one product open and leaking on everything and I’m greatly disappointed.

I'm not canceling my subscription yet. I’m willing to stick it out through January, the last box of my current subscription, to see if the new price and box quantity starts to achieve some semblance of balance. However, I'm incredibly wary and am leaning towards not renewing.

I used to recommend this box to friends. Now I can't advise anybody to spend money on this box.
label: neutral
